title: Direct Visual & Mimir Sieve Ingestion Protocol
heading_path: Multimodal Protocols > Multimodal Engine Protocols > Direct Visual & Mimir Sieve Ingestion Protocol
summary: In Project Fleece Beta, documents with tables, diagrams, and complex typography are processed through the Mimir 3-Pass Progressive Optical Sieve and direct visual projection via MTMDChatHandler (Qwen 3.5 4B Vision Instruct Q8_0 + mmproj-F16). This preserves spatial bounding boxes, prevents table breakage, and avoids text chunking distortion.

title: Visual & Context Token Allocation
heading_path: Multimodal Protocols > Multimodal Engine Protocols > Visual & Context Token Allocation
summary: The working context capacity is set to 65,536 tokens via Native Metal TurboQuant (turbo4/turbo4 KV cache, with automatic q8_0 fallback). Each direct image render is budgeted at 576 visual tokens. When context usage crosses 85%, dialogue history is offloaded to the secondary markdown ledger while preserving visual and document anchors.
